app.title: Pantheon
app.footer: Pantheon Typology. A provisional sorter: the cut-offs have not been normed.

epigraph.text: All things are full of gods.

intro.modelTitle: Seven questions, two gods to each
intro.modelIntro: Each polarity asks one question and sets two gods at its ends. Nobody is all one god. The test finds where you stand on each line, then names the god you lead with and the one who stands across from it.
intro.headline: Find the god you lead with, and the one you neglect.
intro.lede: Fourteen Greek gods stand at the two ends of seven polarities, such as Athena’s composure against Poseidon’s surge. Rate {count} statements and see where you stand on each.
intro.wheelCaption: Each line joins two gods who pull in opposite directions.

facts.detail: Nothing you answer is sent anywhere.
The cut-offs have not been normed yet, so read the result as a first sketch.

quiz.instruction: Compared with most people you know, how true is each statement of you?
quiz.scaleHelp: The five circles run from far less true of you, on the left, to far more, on the right. The middle one means about the same.
quiz.missingOne: 1 statement on this page still needs an answer.
quiz.missingMany: {n} statements on this page still need an answer.

result.neglectedRule: The Greek rule is that every god is owed honour. The one opposite your lead is the one you are most likely to skip.
result.wheelIntro: Each line carries one of your seven points. The further a point sits from the centre, the stronger the pull toward the god at that end. The dotted circles mark where a lean becomes clear, then strong.
result.wheelStrongest: The ringed point and the filled sign mark your strongest pull: {god}.
result.wheelStill: All seven points rest at the centre. No god pulls clearly.
result.wheelSpoken: Your seven points on the wheel. {reading}
result.polaritiesIntro: A bar that reaches further from the centre means a stronger pull toward that god.
result.retakeConfirm: Clear my answers and start again
result.copy: Copy a link to this result
result.sharedNotice: You are looking at a shared result. Your own answers are untouched.
result.incomplete: Answer every statement to see a result.

gods.title: The fourteen gods
gods.intro: Seven polarities with two gods each. In every word-portrait, larger words matter more to the god’s character.

credits.title: The plates
credits.intro: Every statue and painting on this site, with the collection that holds it, the source of the photograph and its licence. The statues are shown in black and white. All pictures are cropped.
